programmes.d: The new doctor (Robert Francis) at a cavalry fort finds resentment at first, even more once he treats Indians.
Farm boy Billy Bonney (Michael J. Pollard) rebels in 1870s Kansas and goes on to become Billy the Kid.
Two Confederates (Joe Namath, Jack Elam) save a man's (Woody Strode) life and cause trouble in 1865 Missouri.
After lying about being a stuntman, a blowhard (Buck Jones) gets the chance to prove himself to a movie studio.
Framed Texan (Robert Knapp) escapes for showdown with saloonkeeper (Walter Coy).
Lawyer Al (Dan Duryea) and brother Frank (Dick Foran) turn to robbing banks and trains after Union troops raid their home.
An Old West gunfighter (Hal Holbrook) turns a young farmer (Jeff Osterhage) into a justice fighter with a special gun.

programmes.t: The New Daughters of Joshua Cabe
programmes.d: A framed sheriff (John McIntire) is about to hang, but his bogus wayward daughters have a plan.
A British scout (Kevin Dillon) infiltrates a French stronghold near the Great Lakes during the 1750s.
A bank robber (Fred MacMurray) takes a new name in another town and falls for the lawyer-sheriff's (Lin McCarthy) sister (Dorothy Green).
A gunman (Randolph Scott) rides into Sundown for a showdown with the big shot (John Carroll) he blames for stealing his wife.
A rancher (Van Heflin) needing cash is hired to put an outlaw (Glenn Ford) on the train to Yuma prison.
Lawman John Corbett (Lee Van Cleef) searches the U.S.-Mexico border for a Mexican peasant (Tomas Milian) accused of raping and killing a 12-year-old girl.
A cowboy discards his chaps and saddle for a suit and tie when he travels to the big city to investigate a produce racket that has been ruining his father's lettuce shipments.

programmes.t: The Law vs. Billy the Kid
programmes.d: Outlaw Billy (Scott Brady) courts a rancher's daughter (Betta St. John) and is hunted by lawman Pat Garrett (James Griffith).
A posse led by an alcoholic sheriff pursues the Drune family after they rob a wealthy rancher. Several days later, the Drunes are all dead, the sheriff is wounded, and the money has disappeared.
A man whose life was saved by an outlaw shows his gratitude by reluctantly assisting in a stagecoach robbery.
